description: This file defines an interface for root-finding algorithms that maintain a bracketed solution in the Apache Commons Math library.

classes.name: BracketedUnivariateSolver
classes.description: An interface for root-finding algorithms that guarantee the solution is within a bracket and support multiple methods for solving within a specified interval.

methods.name: solve (int, FUNC, double, double, AllowedSolution)
methods.description: Finds a root within the interval with a specified maximum number of evaluations, using an allowed solution type.

methods.name: solve (int, FUNC, double, double, double, AllowedSolution)
methods.description: Finds a root within the interval starting from a specific initial guess, with a maximum number of evaluations, using an allowed solution type.
